title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView Apache Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to initiate arbitrary server-side requests on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise OneView. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the REST service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default.
